cd /workspace && cat > tmp/schemafuzz.py <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, json, random, sys, subprocess
def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod
main = load("mysub", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
gen3 = load("gen3", "/workspace/tmp/gen3.py")
gen2 = load("gen2", "/workspace/tmp/gen2.py")
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import schema
bad=0; checked=0
for seed in range(int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    obj = gen3.gen(rng) if seed % 2 else gen2.gen(rng)
    if obj is None: continue
    try:
        got = main.solve(obj)
    except main.Invalid:
        continue
    checked+=1
    try:
        schema.check(got, obj)
    except AssertionError as ex:
        bad+=1; print("SCHEMA FAIL seed",seed,repr(ex)); print(json.dumps(obj)[:400])
        if bad>3: break
print("checked",checked,"schema failures",bad)
PYEOF
timeout 1200 python3 tmp/schemafuzz.py 40000 42500
